problem_type: semantic agent verbs lost identity across transport and approval boundaries
symptom: Valid canonical edit, delete, export, and document requests were rejected or routed with unsupported operation names after preparation.
direct_cause: Preparation translated model-facing verbs to domain transport names, while approval and execution compared the translated or raw wire identity inconsistently; document writes also passed the semantic operation as the transport tool name.
class_root: There was no single normalized RuntimeToolCall identity carried from schema validation through preparation, approval, and execution.
internal_only_reason: This invariant governs internal semantic-to-transport wiring; no external protocol determines approval identity.
invariants: The schema-normalized semantic RuntimeToolCall is the sole approval identity.
Transport translation happens only after identity and authority checks.
A consumed approval cannot be replayed or reused with changed arguments.
Document writes pass the canonical transport method and semantic operation as separate fields.
generality_proof: All deferred write lanes use the same lifecycle and translation boundary, so the normalized identity check covers timeline, canvas, export, skill, generation, and document callers.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: normalize semantic args once, retain the semantic call, and enforce exact identity before crossing a domain adapter
map write_script to the document transport method while preserving operation/content fields
centralize semantic verb to domain transport mapping
keep model-facing examples aligned with the published schema without untranslated UI literals

same_class_entry_points.evidence: 10 tests cover normalization, approval, changed args, replay, receipt correlation, delayed generation, and settlement
canonical document write and deletion journeys assert persisted effects and authority gates
canonical schema declarations are covered by registry and tool-face checks

recurrence.reason: Any newly added semantic verb can be translated to a different domain method and repeat the mismatch unless the shared lifecycle remains authoritative.
same_class_scan: rg semantic verb aliases in electron/agentLane/laneVerbTransport.ts

prevention.invariant: prepare and execute compare the same schema-normalized semantic call before consuming authority
prevention.failure_mode: invalid or changed identity fails closed with capability_authority_invalid
prevention.strategy: retain the semantic call in Pending, normalize execute input with the same schema, then translate only for the adapter

legacy_paths.rationale: The old behavior was an internal comparison and transport bug; no separate persisted legacy path exists.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls this internal identity invariant.

migration: Existing pending approvals are in-memory and are discarded on lane restart; no persisted migration is required.
residual_risks: Real provider generation and full natural-language Electron submission remain to be verified on this branch.
